verdict.rationale: DBOS ships official Python and TypeScript SDKs with extensive documented APIs (workflows, queues, scheduling, testing), plus AI-specific integrations like an OpenAI Agents SDK drop-in runner and a working MCP server verified via keyless probe. missing for 10: no evidence of SDKs beyond Python/TypeScript (community notes lack of .NET support), and no independent third-party SDK quality review beyond a few positive HN anecdotes.
